components.name: Primary Button
components.description: A compact coral action for creating or approving an asset.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: #e46b78; color: #f1f1f1; font: 500 15px/1.35 "PingFang SC", sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1), outline-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #f0818c; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #f1f1f1; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { background: #2b302b; color: #a6aaa3; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: A low-emphasis action for filters, navigation, and secondary asset operations.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { height: 40px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid #ffffff1f; border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; color: #a6aaa3; font: 500 13px/1.35 "PingFang SC", sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1), color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: #202420; color: #f1f1f1; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #e46b78; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Search Field
components.description: A persistent search field for finding assets, projects, and generations.
components.css: .ds-search-label { display: block; } .ds-search { width: 280px; height: 44px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid #ffffff1f; border-radius: 8px; background: #191b19; color: #f1f1f1; font: 400 15px/1.35 "PingFang SC", sans-serif; } .ds-search::placeholder { color: #a6aaa3; } .ds-search:focus-visible { border-color: #e46b78; outline: 2px solid #e46b78; outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-sr-only { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; overflow: hidden; clip: rect(0,0,0,0); white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Navigation Item
components.description: A compact primary navigation row that remains legible when the sidebar collapses.
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; min-height: 40px; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: 8px; color: #a6aaa3; text-decoration: none; font: 500 14px/1.35 "PingFang SC", sans-serif; transition: background-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1), color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1); } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: #202420; color: #f1f1f1; } .ds-nav-item-active { background: #2b2022; color: #f0818c; } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #e46b78; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-nav-icon { width: 18px; text-align: center; color: currentColor; }

components.css: .ds-asset-tile { overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid #ffffff1f; border-radius: 10px; background: #191b19; color: #f1f1f1; } .ds-asset-tile:focus-within { outline: 2px solid #e46b78; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-asset-preview { aspect-ratio: 4 / 5; background: #202420; } .ds-asset-meta { display: grid; gap: 4px; padding: 8px; } .ds-asset-meta strong { font: 600 15px/1.35 "PingFang SC", sans-serif; } .ds-asset-meta span { color: #a6aaa3; font: 400 12px/1.35 "PingFang SC", sans-serif; }

narrative.overview: Bailian Studio is a content-first product interface for generating and reusing short-drama visual assets. Graphite surfaces keep attention on media while a restrained coral signal makes selection and action legible. A low-opacity point field can add spatial atmosphere without changing the product's operational clarity.
keyCharacteristics: Content-first media grids with version context
Graphite tonal layers rather than pure black

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: The coral accent is reserved for primary actions, active navigation, selected assets, and semantic states.

rules.name: The Media Truth Rule
rules.body: Never tint, blur, or overlay an asset thumbnail for atmosphere.

rules.name: The Quiet Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: Prefer one size step and one weight step to clarify a relationship.

rules.name: The Tonal Layer Rule
rules.body: Use surface contrast and a one-pixel border before adding a shadow.

dos: Do make the asset thumbnail, approved version, and reference role visible before secondary metadata.
Do use projects as the primary organizing unit and tags/types as filters.
Do provide a static or Canvas 2D fallback before enabling TypeGPU/WebGPU decoration.
donts: Don't make the product look like a traditional backend with unrelated management menus.
Don't use a pure-black cyberpunk surface, neon borders, scanlines, HUD decorations, or glowing text.
Don't build a flashy AI tool site with gradient text, glassmorphism by default, decorative blobs, or animation that does not communicate state.
Don't create an over-spacious SaaS layout that hides the asset collection behind large empty regions.
